Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.video

Record Class RenderContext

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.jengacode.eduvideo.video.RenderContext
Record Components:
frame - zero-based global output frame index
time - sample or event time in scene-local seconds
settings - validated video output dimensions and frame rate
theme - active semantic palette
scene - owning scene with its object namespace
cameraTransform - camera transform, defensively copied
public record RenderContext(int frame, double time, VideoSettings settings, Theme theme, Scene scene, AffineTransform cameraTransform) extends Record
Per-frame values; time is local to the active scene.

Carries output settings, active scene palette and the scene-local sample time into each object. Camera transforms are copied both on construction and access to prevent shared mutable state.
